name: Mangrove kayaking

seo.title: Mangrove Kayaking on Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Half a day by kayak in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove on Koh Lanta, morning or afternoon, with lunch at the mangrove restaurant and hotel transfer. From 1,000 THB.

h1: Kayaking in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove
lead: Half a day paddling sit-on-top kayaks through the mangrove channels on the east coast of Koh Lanta, past fiddler crabs, herons and monkeys, then lunch at the mangrove restaurant.
promise: Half a day by kayak in the mangrove, with lunch

facts.label: Start
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng pier, east coast

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

options.label: Mangrove kayaking with lunch, half day

day.title: Mangrove kayaking with lunch
day.note: Times with ≈ are approximate and move with the tide and the weather. The afternoon trip follows the same programme from 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the drive to Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast of Koh Lanta.
With the guide, kayaking around the mangrove forest. Watch for fiddler crabs on the mud and for herons and sea eagles over the trees.
A stop to see the monkeys.
Lunch, seasonal fruit and a soft drink at the mangrove restaurant.
End of the trip and transfer back to your hotel.

included: Sit-on-top kayaks, paddles and life jackets

faq.a: Yes. Lunch, a soft drink and seasonal fruit at the mangrove restaurant. The village entrance fee is the only extra.
The morning trip runs from 09:30 to 12:30 and the afternoon trip from 14:00 to 17:00, hotel transfer included. The programme is the same.
Monkeys and birds live in the mangrove and the guide looks out for them on the way. They are wild animals, so we cannot promise them.
Yes. Children from 4 to 11 have their own rate.

faq.q: Can we go in the rainy season?
faq.a: Yes. The mangrove trips run all year.

faq.q: Is the village entrance fee included?
faq.a: No. Thung Yee Peng village charges 40 THB per adult and 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, paid on the spot.

photos.alt: Two guests paddling a kayak among the mangrove roots at Thung Yee Peng
